topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This opening section outlines the lecture's learning objectives, contextualises cancer progression models, and introduces the hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Growth Signal Autonomy and Proliferation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations in signaling cascades such as Wnt/beta-catenin, RTKs, Ras-MAPK, and PI3K drive sustained proliferative signaling and self-sufficiency in growth signals.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells arrest normal lineage maturation across hematological malignancies and intestinal epithelial crypts.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through alterations in p53 regulation and the balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how cancer cells overcome the Hayflick limit and bypass stress-induced senescence through telomerase activation and p53 checkpoint evasion.

topics.label: Altered Cancer Metabolism and Epigenetic Crosstalk
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss metabolic rewiring in tumors, focusing on aerobic glycolysis, onco-metabolites, and their reciprocal interactions with the cancer epigenome.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how tumors induce new blood vessel formation to sustain nutrient perfusion and overcome hypoxia during tumor development.

topics.label: Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the multi-step metastatic cascade, systemic routes of dissemination, diagnostic detection methods, and the seed-and-soil hypothesis.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: This closing section summarises the key takeaways regarding hallmark interactions and concludes the lecture.
